protocol.native: Five warmed runs per version. Final comparison alternates before/after order by pair. Identical SDK, dependency lock, harness and gallery. Baseline runs use an isolated archive of the baseline commit.
protocol.staticFixtures: 1000 warm cycles; final 300 samples per fixture. Ordinary/fallback totals are sums of per-fixture means.
protocol.shortGallery: 100 warm gallery cycles; final five t samples per example, a new tween per example.
protocol.persistentGallery: One reusable tween per indexed example; 60 t values per cycle, five warm cycles and five measured cycles. Totals sum the 18 per-example averages.
protocol.browser: Three interleaved pairs of visible Chrome runs, eight-second warmup and eight-second trace per build. Fixed gallery subset [0,1,2,3,6,11], 200x120 widgets. Identical prebuilt before/after scene. Display events are compositor cadence, not an inference from CPU timings; GPU command metrics measure CPU trace work, not GPU elapsed time.
protocol.statistics: Median and min/max of run averages, except browser callback percentiles calculated within each run. Negative changes mean less time.
